{{2023–24 MEAC men's basketball standings}}
The '''2023–24 North Carolina Central Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[North Carolina Central University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Eagles, led by 15th-year head coach [[LeVelle Moton]], played their home games at [[McDougald–McLendon Arena]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 18–13, 9–5 in MEAC play to finish in a three-way tie for second place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2024 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks men's basketball team|Maryland Eastern Shore]] before losing to [[2023–24 Delaware State Hornets men's basketball team|Delaware State]] in the semifinals.

==Previous season==
The [[2022–23 North Carolina Central Eagles men's basketball team|Eagles]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 18–12, 10–4 in MEAC play to finish in second place.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://meacsports.com/standings.aspx?standings=52|title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings|work=Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference|access-date=November 10, 2023|language=en}}</ref> They defeated [[2022–23 Delaware State Hornets men's basketball team|Delaware State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 MEAC men's basketball tournament|MEAC tournament]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://nccueaglepride.com/news/2023/3/9/mens-basketball-nccu-rains-threes-on-delaware-state-to-advance-to-meac-semifinals.aspx|title=NCCU Rains Threes on Delaware State to Advance to MEAC Semifinals|work=North Carolina Central University Athletics|access-date=November 10, 2023|language=en}}</ref> before falling to [[2022–23 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team|Norfolk State]] in the semifinals.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.pilotonline.com/2023/03/10/norfolk-state-defeats-nc-central-during-semifinal-round-of-meac-tournament/|title=Norfolk State defeats NC Central during semifinal round of MEAC Tournament|work=[[The Virginian-Pilot]]|access-date=November 10, 2023|language=en}}</ref>
